title: Decision tree for privacy impact and contract exception routing
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a deterministic decision tree and routing rules for incoming enterprise security & compliance asks (SOC2/ISO attestation requests, HIPAA inquiries, GDPR/DPA clauses, and vendor questionnaires). The tree will classify requests by privacy/regulatory impact, contractual exception risk, and evidence needs, and then route them to the appropriate lane (self-serve docs, compliance SREs, Legal/Contracts, or escalation for engineering work). The goal is to reduce time-to-first-response for high-risk asks, automate low-risk routing, and produce a reproducible audit trail for customers and auditors.
acceptance_criteria: A decision tree diagram (SVG/Confluence) exists with deterministic routing rules for at least 8 common request archetypes (SOC2 evidence, ISO scope mapping, HIPAA data flow, GDPR DSAR-related clauses, standard DPA, custom contract clause exception, penetration-test evidence, on-prem deployment questionnaire)
Automated classifier prototype (serverless lambda) ingests sample questionnaire and returns a routing label and priority with >=85% precision on a labelled test set
Routing map integrates with intake system to assign lane: documentation (self-serve), compliance queue, legal-contract review, or engineering backlog with SLA tiers defined
Defined evidence templates for each lane (list of docs, retention expectations, who owns communication) and a sample customer response package generated from templates
Escalation matrix documented: when to open a contract exception, when to require a PIA/DPIA, and when to schedule an on-site/attestation call
Telemetry events and audit-log schema documented for tracing request -> decision -> artifact bundle
work_items: Hold kickoff with Legal, Security, Compliance, and Solutions Engineering (2026-03-03): gather top 20 archetypes
Draft decision tree in Confluence and circulate for review (due 2026-03-08)
Build classifier prototype using existing questionnaire corpus; evaluate with labelled set
Define lane-specific evidence templates and owner contacts
Add routing integration spec to intake API (webhook + labels)
Pilot routing with 3 enterprise customers for 4 weeks and collect metrics (TTR, re-routes, false positives)
Iterate thresholds and add fallback manual review lane for edge cases
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Thompson: Kickoff done. Legal provided 12 real customer questionnaires and prioritized SOC2/ISO, DPA, and HIPAA as top archetypes.
2026-03-05 Arjun Patel: Prototype classifier started. Using heuristics + small fine-tuned text classifier. Initial precision on SOC2 detection 90% but DPA clause detection noisy (68%).
2026-03-06 Jamie Rivera (Legal): Request to add contract clause matcher for 6 common exception phrases. Will provide labelled examples by 2026-03-09.

2026-03-07 Priya Menon (Security): For high-risk PHI hits, we must require Security review and flag for Private deployment. Add this rule to the tree. Also suggested adding a 'requires-encryption-at-rest' boolean in evidence template.

2026-03-09 Arjun Patel: Trade-off discussion: raising classifier threshold reduces false positives but increases manual reviews. Proposal: pilot with lower threshold and human-in-loop for first 100 requests, then tighten.
2026-03-10 Maya Thompson: Decided to pilot routing with three customers (alpha banks) who have frequent DPA follow-ups. They agreed to 2-week SLA for follow-up clarification.
2026-03-12 Engineering note (ENG-1842): Need an intake API field 'regulatory_scope' and 'contract_risk_score' to support routing; blocked until API changes land (target 2026-03-20).
2026-03-14 Arjun Patel: Updated decision tree with Legal's clause matcher. Next: wire telemetry schema and prepare evidence templates.
